text: APPROVE: The extracted helpers keep the original short-circuit order and the same trimmed and untrimmed arguments, so behaviour is unchanged. Merging the lookup-key check into the existing `continue` condition is equivalent. The removed ternary chain, long `||` gate and extra `if` should bring the method under 15, and nothing in the diff looks likely to break the build, though I couldn't compile it or measure the complexity here and assumed `lines` is a `string[]` and `name` a `Match`.
